snic_departamental.name: SNIC - Departamental. Estadísticas criminales en la República Argentina por departamentos (panel anual)
snic_departamental.publisher: Ministerio de Seguridad Nacional, Sistema Nacional de Información Criminal (SNIC), via datos.gob.ar
snic_departamental.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (as stated on datos.gob.ar)
snic_departamental.notes: Kept SNIC codes 1 'Homicidios dolosos', 2 'Homicidios dolosos en grado de tentativa' (attempted) and 4 'Homicidios culposos por otros hechos' (culpable homicide other than road traffic), each with every published column: incidents (hechos), victims total/male/female/sex not determined, and the published rates per 100,000 for incidents, victims, male victims and female victims. 'NA' cells skipped (not published). Decimal commas converted to points; no other change. Not kept: code 3 road deaths, code 17 robbery aggravated by injury and/or death (mixes injuries and deaths), code 31 suicides. Departmental file also has a monthly-by-sex version (snic-departamentos-mes-sexo.csv) listed on datos.gob.ar, but its URL returns 404.

problems: geoBoundaries ARG ADM1 has no Entre Ríos polygon (23 features), so Entre Ríos province rows have no shape; its departments do exist in ADM2 and are matched. geoBoundaries ADM2 has names only (no INDEC codes): matched by name within province, then by nationally unique name for Greater Buenos Aires partidos and other border cases whose simplified shape sat in the neighbouring province, then by hand for spelling variants ('Coronel Felipe Varela'=General Felipe Varela, 'General Angel V. Peñaloza', 'El Dorado'=Eldorado, 'Pelegrini', 'Famallá', 'Pilnaniyeu', 'Paso de los Indios'=Paso de Indios, '1ro. de Mayo'); San Luis 'Juan Martín de Pueyrredón' matched to geoBoundaries 'La Capital' (same department, renamed); the two 'Colón' departments split by location (Buenos Aires west, Entre Ríos east). Code 06058 is labelled 'Quilmes' in the source from 2017 while Quilmes also appears as 06658; left unmatched. La Pampa rows 42001-42004 in some years are police regional units (Centro, Norte, Sur, Oeste), not departments, so unmatched. 'Departamento sin determinar' rows (x999) are place-unknown.
